name: materialised-language-per-language-bucket
body: A materialised `applies-to` `Language` root reports its `Language` kind increment correctly, but its per-language tally lands in the last-selected stream bucket, because the admission does not re-select the target language (matching the streamed-admission sibling). Limit: the closing per-language line can attribute an authored-only language to another stream's bucket. Upgrade: re-select the materialised target's language bucket when the per-language line must attribute an authored-only Language to itself.
